lesson: Magic's pretraining lesson is that production formatting is part of the pretraining distribution and can materially change measured loss; therefore the production-formatted view is retained, but an independently implemented extraction is scored separately so one parser cannot define the conclusion.

views.production_formatted: the exact selection-heldout JSONL emitted and authorized by the existing firewall
views.parser_independent: a separate file produced by an alternate parser/extractor and paired only by immutable source/document identity
views.decision: parser-independent equal-category macro BPB is the primary ranking view; every category guardrail must pass independently in both views

identity.training_scope: one aggregate ledger covering every tokenizer-training and model-training identity relevant to the evaluation
identity.selection_and_audit_binding: ordered normalized-content hashes must reproduce each category/partition commitment in the immutable firewall manifest

bounds.real_values: must be frozen in an executable successor before materialization; this plan does not invent held-out or audit sizes

leakage.window_rule: all sliding normalized character windows; any training/held-out match fails
leakage.jaccard: exact token-shingle Jaccard over every pair inside the declared bound; candidate approximation cannot authorize a pass
leakage.action: either additional channel fails the bundle

statistics.primary_score: unweighted macro mean of the six category paired deltas
statistics.subdomains: reported beneath their formal category with zero independent decision weight

cross_backend_parity.scope: identical external-model identity and complete two-view document set through two distinct hash-bound backends
cross_backend_parity.comparison: maximum absolute per-document NLL difference against a predeclared tolerance

requires: production firewall with immutable real bounds and passing rights/operations records
aggregate training identity ledger and bound selection/audit commitment ledgers
production formatter and independent parser/extractor artifacts with immutable revisions and hashes
pre-results model, backend, bootstrap, and numerical-tolerance manifests
